title: Кадр 3.8: Рух со всадниками летят издалека высоко, люди после битвы живые, в конце замирают

set.vid: locked-off wide shot. A wedge of about ten giant Rukh birds with riders appears far away high in the sky above the right ridges and flies toward the camera, staying high above the field; below, the exhausted crowds breathe heavily and sway, wounded lean on spears, banners and torn cloaks whip in the hot wind, heads turn up one after another, a horse tosses its head; as the flock passes high overhead and its shadows sweep the field, everyone freezes, staring up
set.continuity: Alliance survivors on the LEFT edge of the square, drayks on the RIGHT; the Rukh wedge comes from the far right, high in the sky, toward the camera
